findings.summary: The incorporated security package does not completely close SEC-G2-R2-001. The governing round-two closure text names `steer-permissions-manifest/v6`, while the exact package manifest binds a permissions artifact whose declared version is `steer-permissions-manifest/v9`; neither the remediation validator nor the protected-action decision validates that version, so the canonical Exam and executable oracle disagree about the normative permission schema. The executable hostile-role coverage is also incomplete relative to the prior required resolution and the Exam's own section 3: the 65 passing authorization cases contain no distinct originator or worker protected-path case, the platform-agent case is only a downstream-principal substitution, and `AUTH-EXAM-BUILDER` and `AUTH-EXAM-COMPROMISED` use the identical `actor-role` mutation, which always substitutes `builder`. The package can therefore report a complete passing declared matrix without proving each named principal and retry/fallback pathway against protected App-authored Exam work.
findings.requiredResolution: Make the canonical Exam and the bound permission artifact name the same exact schema/version and make the validator reject any version mismatch. Preserve the existing normal-item protected-path case, replace the duplicate compromised case with a genuinely distinct coherent compromised-caller case, and add independently executed originator, platform-agent, worker, retry, and fallback protected-path negatives with the applicable upstream credential, authority, delegation, assignment, selector, path, and actor-role bytes coherently varied. Every row must deny before operational credential or installation-token exchange and produce the complete typed zero-effect ledger. Refresh every affected digest and obtain a new exact-revision independent review.

The commercial default-closed policy requires Security specialist escalation unless a revised exact target aligns the normative permission schema and executes the complete named hostile-principal matrix; this reviewer cannot accept or waive the residual risk.
